p.i: tatio) sed cum tot efferis gigantibus, Socinianis, Pelagianis, Antinomis, Anabaptistis, Erastianis, aliisque succrescentibus quotidie velut Hydrae capitibus novis hæreseon monstris, quorum vix audita vulgo nomina, nedum satis explorata dogmata, manus conserere. Cogitate cujus sit artis, anguillas illas lubricas & caeno gaudentes, sed quid ego anguillas dico? apage deminutiva; quin angues potius μεςῦς ἰὰ θανατηφόρος (Sectarios, inquam, & sophistas) e cavis & limo quibus se abdiderunt eruere, in lucem protrahere, ita constrictos tenere, nequâ aut toxico noceant, aut elabantur lubrico. Cogitate quantæ sit solertiæ, latentem sub ovilla veste lupum deprehendere; Detrahere & pellem nitidus qua quisque per ora Cederet intror-

page.notes: Greek words "μεςῦς ἰὰ" and "θανατηφόρος" are uncertain; the first Greek phrase may be misread. "hæreseon" is uncertain in its last letters. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The line-end "in-" / "intror-" is kept as printed; the last line "tror-" is treated as the catchword.
